content:
Amazon's Labor Day sale is in full swing, and beyond the thousands of deals, there's also the AirTag 2 at an all-time low starting at $20 each, plus M6 Mac mini pre-order deals (don't forget to grab the $9 new Apple Polishing Cloth while supplies last). But in today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break, we'll be focusing on Amazon Resale's Apple product discounts — MagSafe Charger external batteries, AirPods, Apple Pencil and more at up to 40% off. We also have the Satechi Hub & Stand with SSD enclosure for the M6 Mac mini marked down to $64 (35% off), plus updated Amazon Anker Labor Day deals starting from $12. If you're looking to get a Nintendo Switch 2, there's less than 24 hours before a price increase, so make sure to place your order before tomorrow's hike. Read on to see today's best deals.

Amazon's massive 2026 Labor Day sale kicks off! Thousands of deals on Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, even starting from $5

Amazon now selling new 2026 Apple Polishing Cloth, Prime members get it for $9 with shipping, grab it before it sells out

Apple deals starting to disappear, scoop up AirTag 2 at its all-time low while supplies last (just $20 each)

Amazon's massive Labor Day sale has launched early again this year, but some of the most eye-catching Apple deals are already being snapped up — you'll need to act fast if you want one. The brand-new AirTag 2 is still holding at its all-time low price.

Amazon currently has a single AirTag 2 on sale at its all-time low price — you can get one for $24 with Prime free shipping.

But the real bombshell is the 4-pack going for $79.99 with free shipping, which many are calling one of the best Apple deals of the year.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (was $29) — matches all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (was $99) — new all-time low

This is the all-time low price, dropping Apple's upgraded 2026 item tracker to just $20 each. Being able to pick up a brand-new Apple product for $20 with Prime free shipping at any time is well worth serious consideration.

Amazon Resale price drops: MagSafe Charger external battery, AirPods, Apple Pencil and more up to 40% off

Amazon's 2026 Labor Day sale is racing ahead, and beyond the great deals on brand-new items, Amazon Resale's Apple product markdowns are also incredibly steep — you can save an additional 30% at checkout. See details below.

AirTag 2 at an all-time low starting at $20 each, AirPods Pro 3 deals, and M6 Mac mini pre-order offers are still available; if you move fast enough, there are also some pretty attractive deals on Apple accessories.

All of the following deals are Amazon Resale's highest quality tier:

  • AirPods 4 $80 (was $129 new)
  • Apple Pencil Pro $74 with free shipping (was $129 new)
  • Apple Pencil USB-C $55 (was $69)
  • iPhone Air MagSafe Charger external battery $39 (was $99 new), new units on special at $59

Deals on 'Like New' condition items like these typically don't last long, so you'll want to place your order quickly.

***Note: After clicking the link above, select the 'Resale – Like New' listings.

Satechi Hub & Stand with SSD enclosure for M6/M5 Pro/M4 Mac mini marked down to $65 (35% off)

We've been tracking the new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro model pre-order deals throughout Amazon's Labor Day sale. And Satechi's Mac mini-designed Hub & Stand with NVMe SSD enclosure is now 35% off — compatible with M6, M5 Pro and M4 Mac mini.

Satechi's official Amazon store has the Mac mini Hub & Stand with NVMe SSD enclosure marked down to $64.74 with free shipping; be sure to click the coupon on the page to get the discount.

This retails for $100, and even on sale rarely drops below $75. Today's offer is better than the 25% off we previously mentioned, saving you 36%, making it one of the best prices this year.

This model is the same one Satechi released last year for the M4 Mac mini, but it's also compatible with the all-new M6 and M5 Pro models that Apple just unveiled last week and began accepting pre-orders for. There are plenty of knockoffs on the market, but Satechi's is the real deal — it looks and feels almost like it was designed in Cupertino.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro discounted by up to $291 [Updated]

Update 8/26: Prices have been cut further:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,215 (was $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,215 (was $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (was $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,166 (was $1,299 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171 (was $1,299 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170 (was $1,299 new) — all-time low

Although Apple's official Certified Refurbished store is my first choice for buying a discounted iPhone, Apple hasn't yet started selling the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there — it looks like we'll have to wait until after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed listings have now returned to Prime Day pricing levels, saving you up to $220 versus new.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed units have always been the most affordable way to get an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Beyond saving hundreds of dollars, you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and 'battery life maintained at 90% or above' — Amazon's non-'Premium' Renewed and Refurbished listings only come with 90 days of warranty, and the battery life can't compare.

The cheapest 24GB M5 MacBook Air is now $150 off

Since the price increase, deals on the latest M5 MacBook Air have been harder to find outside of Apple's official Refurbished store. We've seen a few decent short-term deals on Amazon's Sky Blue model, but today we found the cheapest 24GB configuration going for $150 off in silver.

B&H has the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB RAM and 512GB SSD marked down to $1,449 with free shipping.

That's $150 off this $1,599 configuration. Other colors are also on sale, but only $100 off.

This configuration is typically only available at smaller authorized resellers, Apple itself, and official Apple resellers like B&H. The only 24GB M5 MacBook Air on Amazon is the model with 1TB of storage, originally priced at $1,799 (now $100 off) — the model we're featuring today is the cheapest 24GB configuration on the market.

Ongoing: Anker's new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card supports iOS or Android, down to $25 — Amazon all-time low

Anker recently launched a brand-new SmartTrack Find My Card wallet card — their first product that supports both Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — now discounted to an Amazon all-time low of $25 with Prime free shipping.

Anker's official EufyHome Amazon store has the brand-new SmartTrack Card E40 wallet card (iOS or Android) marked down to $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

This product only went on sale at Amazon for $35 last month, with a slight $5 discount later in the same month, and is now seeing its first significant price drop, hitting an Amazon all-time low.

That's nearly 29% off, matching some of the better deals we've tracked this year on similar wallet tracker cards.

Labor Day deals kick off today: here are our top picks, grab them now

Amazon now offering pre-order deals on the two cheapest brand-new M6 Mac mini models

After kicking off the Labor Day mega-sale, Amazon is making another move to get you to pre-order the M6 Mac mini — they've marked down the two cheapest configurations slightly. The discount isn't huge, but this is currently the only reputable place where you can get a brand-new M6 Mac mini at a discount. Don't forget to grab an $9 Apple Polishing Cloth with Prime free shipping before it sells out.

Yesterday afternoon we spotted Amazon discounting the base 16GB/256GB model, and now the mid-tier 16GB/512GB model has joined the discount lineup:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (was $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (was $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

Considering the new Mac mini starts at $899, today's discounts may not seem like much, but remember these models aren't officially on sale yet (shipping begins September 22). If you're pre-ordering without a trade-in, every dollar saved helps — put it toward gas or a coffee.

As expected, the brand-new M6 Mac mini is still selling at full price at other Apple authorized retailers and Apple itself as of now. The 24GB M6 or M5 Pro models haven't seen any discounts at all yet, but we'll keep watching.
